provisionalPlatform: linux/arm64 Docker Desktop on Apple M3 Max

aa.method: six baseline aggregates from two consecutive ordering passes (three distinct-seed baseline stability evals each); each aggregate is the arithmetic mean of the train and validation per-split q, where per-split q is the geomean over workloads of the paired ref/cand yardstick ratio

estimator: interleaved pristine-reference yardstick: per workload, paired geomean over 9 back-to-back candidate/reference pairs of (reference chain time / candidate chain time); the per-pair ratio cancels shared host load so the aggregate is stable under the contended host (stability spread 0.0265 << 0.15 band)

rss.source: kernel cgroup2 memory.peak (whole-tree, non-resettable) via trusted remount; replaces round-2 VmRSS 5 ms polling

correctness.identityGate: single session-finish nonce-authenticated summary compared against the frozen exact pass/skip node-id identity sha256 (not counts)
correctness.dumpGate: byte-exact SHA-256 (pristine canonical) + per-iteration chain vs pristine reference
correctness.loadsGate: canonical semantic SHA-256 + per-iteration chain vs pristine reference

controls.description: loads returns a null result without an exception; upstream pytest gate + chain oracle catch it
deliberately slower but correct entrypoint loops
independently authored AArch64 NEON escaped-string fast path
validation-fixture-length fingerprint control beats baseline on train, split-gated below baseline on validation

seedPilots.harnessNote: The per-pilot aggregates below were measured under the ROUND-2 absolute-throughput harness and are on a different (ops/sec) scale than the round-4 interleaved-yardstick q; they are retained for provenance. The qualitative gate they establish (>=1 valid non-baseline candidate per pilot AND the search reference not reached) is re-evidenced under the round-4 harness by the 2x ordering headroom: the improved control clears qReference by ~8 sigma while remaining a bounded, non-saturating gain.

referenceTest.formula: trainReference = orderingBaselineTrain * (qReference / qBase) under the round-4 yardstick
